Seated core row

Plank
   Get into a push-up position, but instead of lowering down, hold yourself up in a straight line from head to heels. This is the single most effective exercise for building core strength. You can do a plank for 30 seconds to a minute, or add more complex variations until you feel challenged. Crunch

Side plank
   Lie on your side with your forearm on the ground and your elbow directly under your shoulder. Lift your hips off the ground, keeping your body in a straight line from your head to your heels. Return to starting position and repeat on the other side. For variety, you can also try side planks on the side with your elbow under your head. If you have time, do two planks in a row, then switch sides, and repeat for 10-12 reps.

Russian twist
   Sit on the ground with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor. Lean back slightly and lift your feet off the ground, balancing on your sitting bones. Hold a weight, a medicine ball, or a water bottle in each hand and alternate bringing the weights around your sides, until you have turned to the other side. Repeat for 10-12 reps.

Bird dog
   Get into a forward bend with your knees bent and your feet flat on the ground. Hold your arms out in front of you with your palms facing down, and lift your hips off the ground. Return to starting position and repeat for 10-12 reps.
